note: Website-to-showreel prompt recipe distilled from the IG General-section read (cluster C2B-02). The recipe is a prompt workflow, not a renderer: an operator runs the emitted prompt pack in an LLM tool session that has git/terminal access, and that session produces the video. VyralX stores the recipe and emits filled prompt packs; the fleet itself does not render this recipe, and no output of it may be described as autonomously produced by the fleet. The verbatim source prompt is preserved in the recipe's source block; the parameterised template differs from it only by the named slots, plus one labelled extension clause for the brand-identity slot.

recipes.brand_clause_template: Match the site's brand identity throughout: {brand_identity}.
hard_rules: Free-only: the recipe runs on free-tier LLM access the fleet already has; voiceover and music come from the same free sources VyralX already uses - no paid generation APIs, no paid stock or music libraries.
The fleet does not render this recipe: the render happens inside the operator-run LLM tool session. Never describe a showreel made with this recipe as autonomously produced by the fleet.
Any showreel produced with this recipe enters VyralX's normal production pipeline and must pass the five quality gates before any upload consideration; the autopilot timer rules are unchanged.
If this recipe is ever driven programmatically, its model calls route through Inference, like the rest of VyralX.
Use only the target site's own brand assets and identity; no third-party characters or IP.
recipes.honest_boundary: This asset adds a reusable prompt recipe and a prompt-pack emission helper to VyralX. It does NOT add an on-fleet video-rendering capability: the render itself happens inside an LLM tool session with git/terminal access, run by an operator.
recipes.name: Website to 45-second motion-graphics showreel
recipes.post_production: A produced showreel is a normal VyralX production candidate: it goes through the five quality gates before any upload consideration, and the autopilot timer rules are unchanged.
recipes.prompt_template: We are making the video for this website {site_url} make a dynamic {duration_seconds} second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a resume. go all out. Add {voiceover_style} voiceover and {music_mood} music
session_requirements: Run the filled prompt in a high-effort session of a top-tier LLM tool (the source recipe names 'claude Opus 5.5 on high effort' [sic]).
Connect the session to the target site's git repository or project files, or run it in the project's connected terminal (the source recipe's best-results condition).
The session needs tool/terminal access to fetch the site and assemble the video; VyralX and the fleet do not render this recipe.
Free-only: use only free-tier LLM access the fleet already has; no paid generation APIs and no paid stock or music libraries.

slots.description: Public URL of the website the showreel is for (the source prompt's '<add the link>').
slots.name: site_url

slots.description: Showreel length in seconds; 45 in the source recipe.
slots.name: duration_seconds

slots.description: Voiceover style adjective(s); 'professional' in the source recipe.
slots.name: voiceover_style

slots.description: Music brief; 'high production' in the source recipe.
slots.name: music_mood

slots.description: Brand colours/identity for the target site. VyralX parameterisation extension (the packet's slot list); emitted as an extra clause only when provided. When omitted, the session takes the identity from the site itself.
slots.name: brand_identity

verbatim_method_notes: Add your website link and enter the prompt with claude Opus 5.5 on high effort
For Best Results: Connect your git or project file to claude or use this in claude connected terminal of your project.
source.verbatim_prompt: We are making the video for this website <add the link> make a dynamic 45 second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a resume. go all out. Add professional voiceover and high production music

structure.note: the site's hero moment lands in the first seconds
dynamic tour of the site's key screens and flows
features assemble as motion graphics; pace rises
brand payoff: identity lockup and one closing line

recipes.structure_provenance: VyralX production-side structuring of the recipe's single-paragraph brief into timed beats (the source prompt names no beats); used for the emitted production spec only.
